content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The Agreement's only liability limitation (p0077, at the end of the indemnity section) caps TrueLink alone at 12 months' hosting/support compensation and leaves Client entirely uncapped — walk-away territory under LOL-CAP, and it also fails fallback carve-outs (indemnification and confidentiality sit inside the cap). I proposed a single surgical replacement making the cap mutual, retaining the existing 12-month fees basis, carving out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct, and curing the dangling references to non-existent Sections 3, 4 and 11.
